summary: Hydra Markets - orphaned streaming responses and truncated transcripts during autoscale resulting in billed partial completions
description:
Issue summary:
During a customer-visible autoscaling event on 2026-03-10 02:40-03:05 UTC, Hydra Markets observed a high rate of streaming responses that terminated early (truncated transcripts) while tokens were still billed. Some client sessions showed 'stream completed' but server-side traces indicated the response path had been orphaned mid-KV-rehydration. Impact: partial completes were billed as full token charges, customers saw truncated outputs and repeated requests to retry.

Impact:
- Multiple Hydra endpoints experienced ~7–12% of streaming requests truncating mid-response for ~25 minutes.
- Hydra reported a billing delta (estimated) of ~1.8M tokens billed for partial responses during the window.
- Customer escalated to on-call SRE and requested an RCA and credit.

Timeline (high level):
- 02:39 UTC: autoscaler triggered a scale-up of a gpu-pool due to short spike in concurrent streaming traffic.
- 02:40–02:50 UTC: increased 5xx and stream disconnects; many streams show final FIN signals but no final 'done' event in application logs.
- 03:00 UTC: mitigations applied (autoscaler threshold adjusted, draining heuristic changed to 'wait-for-kv-rehydrate').
- 03:15 UTC: metrics returned to baseline; billing exposure window closed.

Environment:
- Production cluster: us-east-1, dedicated GPU pool for Hydra (tenant-dedicated).
- Runtime image: rwd-runtime-2026-02-26 (kernel-selection v3).

Steps to reproduce (approx):
1) Start long-running streaming completion with prefix caching enabled and sequence length > 1200 tokens.
2) Trigger scale event by sending burst of concurrent streams.
3) Observe in tracing that the downstream serving node begins migration/drain while kv-cache rehydration is still pending and client stream gets closed by LB.

Relevant logs & traces:
- Trace IDs: trace.us-east.abcde: 8f7a3c, 8f7a95, 8f7b02 (representative).
- Application log sample: "WARN serving-runtime: client stream closed while rehydrating KV; orphaned token flush scheduled"
- Load balancer logs show upstream 200 then downstream FIN without final application 'completion' event.

Immediate mitigation taken:
- Adjusted autoscaler grace period to allow in-flight KV rehydration to finish before draining.
- Updated load balancer idle timeout for streaming routes to 60s for affected pool.
- Issued temporary bill hold for Hydra while we validated records.

Customer request:
- Full RCA, token-level billing reconciliation, and service credits for impacted minutes/tokens.
comments: 2026-03-10 03:20 - Hydra Ops (Leah N.) : We saw truncated outputs and clients report having to resend requests multiple times. Please advise ETA on fix and whether we will receive credits.
2026-03-10 03:35 - Support (Riley Carter) : On-call SRE has been paged and we are investigating. We have temporarily paused billing for the affected pool while we collect traces. Will update in 30m.

2026-03-10 04:05 - SRE (Aisha Malik) : Root cause candidate: autoscaler drain preempted KV rehydration for high-prefix sessions, leading to orphaned stream state. Applying drain-wait heuristic now. Will run replay against captured traces to quantify billed tokens.

2026-03-10 10:12 - Support (Riley Carter) to Hydra Ops : We've completed a preliminary token reconciliation; estimated exposure 1.8M tokens (subject to final audit). We're preparing a formal RCA and credit proposal.
2026-03-12 09:00 - Customer (Leah N.) : Thank you for the updates. We want the RCA and the timeline for the permanent fix. Also need to know what monitoring will prevent recurrence.
2026-03-12 15:30 - Engineering (Marco Diaz) : PR created to change drain behavior and add stream-orphan metric: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287. Rolling out to canary now.
2026-03-13 11:45 - Support (Riley Carter) : Final RCA posted and credits applied. Hydra confirmed receipt and accepted the post-incident plan. Marking ticket resolved.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Autoscaler drain shortened node lifetime before KV cache rehydration completed for large prefixes. Evidence: traces show rehydration start times overlapping with node drain signal.

Hypothesis 2: LB idle timeout triggered a FIN before app-level completion was emitted when rehydration stalls exceeded idle threshold. Evidence: LB logs show FIN within 2s of upstream 200 in affected traces.

Quantification approach: replay sampled traces through a replay harness that simulates drain timings and measures where 'completion' events are suppressed. Initial replay recreates truncation in 92% of sampled traces when drain issued within rehydrate window.
Telemetry gaps identified: no explicit metric for 'streams orphaned during drain' prior to this incident. Added metric 'stream_orphan_during_drain' and dashboard tile.
resolution: Permanent fix deployed: adjusted autoscaler drain behavior to wait for KV rehydration completion or max 30s; increased LB streaming idle timeout; added stream-orphan metric and alert. Charging pause for the affected pool was applied during the incident window and a token credit of 2.0M tokens was issued to Hydra to cover uncertainty margin.
resolution_notes:
- Deployed runtime fix (PR #1287) to 20% canary on 2026-03-11, full rollout 2026-03-12 after smoke tests.
- Billing team applied 2.0M token credit on 2026-03-12 and confirmed in billing system (ticket FIN-4521).
- Post-incident action items: 1) Add automated replay test to CI for autoscaler drain scenarios (owner: Serving Runtime), 2) Add runbook step to immediately pause billing on tenant-level anomalies (owner: Support Ops), 3) Improve customer-facing incident notifications for transient billing exposures (owner: Customer Success).
- Customer accepted credit and closed escalation on 2026-03-13.
post_incident_action_items: Create CI replay test covering KV rehydration + drain: issue INT-3610 assigned to Marco Diaz
Add 'stream_orphan_during_drain' alert to PagerDuty with severity mapping: P0 if >1% of streams in 5m
Update autoscaler runbook to include 'hold draining if rehydration in-progress' step
Billing Ops to create automatic temporary bill hold checklist and make it actionable from Support Console
